svg.title: 36. Happy baby stretch — female orange flat color illustration
svg.desc: Lie on your back and bring both knees towards your chest. Move the knees apart and hold behind the thighs or hold the feet. Let your lower back stay heavy on the mat as your knees move towards your armpits.
svg.metadata: Created with built-in image generation using the approved orange female illustration as character and style reference. Converted to curved SVG paths with VTracer. Exercise guide source: https://www.wchc.nhs.uk/services/pelvic-health/pelvic-stretches/
